description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  
 • Provide architectural and design support/direction for Java development teams
 • Help develop a base framework which can be leveraged by other Java developers as libraries
 • Help develop the style sheets for the same look and feel based on the direction provided by creative services team
 • Leverage expertise in enterprise JSF patterns with SOA-based ESBs to develop or extend legacy system integration with the SOA Architecture
 • Help develop the application architecture governance process
 • Ensure that the team follows the development standards, guidelines, and development methodology as specified in the development and testing approach - provide input into development and testing to ensure a quality product.
 • Participate in or guide code reviews
 • Support the operation of a continuous integration environment, including development of automated test cases (unit and functional), build and release management support, and defect correction support
 • Perform Java development activities as part of a scrum team 
  
 CHARACTERISTICS AND QUALIFICATIONS
  
 This job requires excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with others. Feedback and suggestions on processes are needed. Works under minimum supervision. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
 Required:
 • Bachelors or more advanced degree
 • 5 years or more experience as a Java developer in a technical organization writing software applications
 • Excellent customer support including good communication, written and verbal skills and problem solving ability
 • Demonstrated ability to debug and maintain complex systems, particularly those created by other developers with minimal available documentation
 • J2EE
 • Agile SCRUM exposure
 • JSF
 • jQuery
 • *Faces
 



 Title: JSF Developer
 Location: King of Prussia, PA
 Duration: 24+ months
 Interview Mode : F2F
